title: Five-particle ABD Newton cradle

governing_assumptions: Finite-stiffness affine rigidity and revolute hinges; massless suspension arms
Average-acceleration Newmark [0.5,0.25,0.5], matching the completed12s reference; the README animation shows only its first5 impacts. Finite penalties are not calibrated steel

geometry.description: Five equal near-spherical closed 2562-vertex,5120-triangle meshes with independent fixed pivots; first ball released from20 degrees
geometry.coordinate_frame: x horizontal row, y hinge axis, z upward

discretization.particle_or_template_resolution: 2562 vertices and5120 triangles per ball; icosphere_subdiv4.obj normalized to radius0.05m
discretization.refinement_plan: The1GPa, dt1e-4, Newmark[.5,.25,.5] CUDA/f64 run completed12s with8measured returns and passed case acceptance; temporal and mesh convergence remain separate checks.

materials.name: identical pendulum balls
materials.provenance: Standard demonstration assumptions; rigidity penalty is not a calibrated steel constitutive law

initial_conditions.state_variables: Undeformed, zero velocity; first center elevated on its pivot circle

contact_or_coupling.law: BarrierIPC triangle PT/EE with BVH and CCD

time.stability_policy: Fixed nominal step; any nonlinear or linear failure aborts; no silent timestep retry

validation.observable: README-reference horizontal transfer; target8 visible returns, at least7 accepted
validation.evidence: CUDA/f64 reference completed12s with8measured returns; maximum certified energy ratio1.0000000145170336, final contact-free retention0.9766770564490858. This is case acceptance, not a temporal/mesh convergence certificate.

invariants.basis: User accepts the README reference effect and excludes vertical vibration from the horizontal transfer criterion; retain the5% horizontal diagnostic and require7-8visible returns.
Hinge anchor drift below 0.04% of the 0.5 m arm; penalty support mg/k is about 4e-6 m
Symmetric x-z pendulum motion must stay within 10 micrometers of its y-plane
No energy creation beyond1e-6 relative numerical allowance; dissipation is permitted. Full potential is checked only at certified contact-free frames; kinetic+gravity in every frame.

refinement_gate.scope: Diagnostic only; do not block later independent cases after failed acceptance.

first_transfer_gate.measurement: Outgoing snapshot when last ball first crosses x=rest_x+0.01 m with positive x velocity within the first reference half-period; striker/middle ratios are maximum absolute horizontal center speeds over the subsequent observed forward-flight window. Energy is evaluated separately only at certified contact-free frames.
first_transfer_gate.basis: User target is near one-ball-to-one-ball transmission; tighter than old sanity gate and independent of total energy conservation.
first_transfer_gate.outgoing_observable: End ball advances>0.01m with positive horizontal speed; amplitude/velocity may decay.

round_trip_counter.event: negative-to-positive horizontal velocity crossing on the raised side
round_trip_counter.basis: User accepts decay; count1cm visible returns, rejecting small residual wobble.

validation.normalized_error_definition: max(striker_horizontal_ratio/0.05,middle_horizontal_ratio/0.05); for long runs also7/max(completed_round_trips,1). All checks are reported; failure does not block independent cube/bunny cases.

assumptions: 5 equal particles, radius 0.05 m, suspension length 0.5 m, release 20 degrees
2.2 mm initial surface gap keeps the IPC initial geometry strictly feasible and outside activation
No friction, physical damping, motor, or servo; hinge axes fixed in world
The collision and all nonlinear/linear numerical work remain in Taichi fields; NumPy is used only for setup and saved-output diagnostics
Near-unit peak outgoing speed is not itself an energy balance; finite facets, simultaneous contacts and finite penalties can distribute energy among several balls

Case-specific regularization: kappa2e16, hinge position/axis penalties1e7, original ABD rigidity1e9. Mesh refinement removes large faceting-induced residual transfer; increasing rigidity alone did not fix it. Numerical solver tolerances and zero physical damping/friction are preserved.

Displayed README animation: first5impacts over0-3.605s from the completed12s/8returns reference; Newmark[.5,.25,.5], dt1e-4, rigidity1GPa, imageSHA2567057505b14a6e8f5a2986984255cbde6233ee7bcb310f2949e3fd605f1b2ee10. The2TPa short trials do not replace this validated reference.
unresolved: Temporal and mesh convergence of the regularized contact model remain unverified.
At2TPa, dt1e-4 failed the energy standard despite100x tighter Newton/PCG; dt5e-5 passed a controlled first-impact comparison, but a fresh12s2TPa trajectory remains unverified.
